subject: Rep steps now reference strategy step indexes
body: Under D-coord-012 a full rep is rate, anchor, then a strategy-step per step in the person's own order ({kind:'strategy-step', strategyStepIndex, driverIndexes?}), then peak, then rate. leverage stays as its own kind. Anchor-only is rate, anchor, rate, and a sham logs only the rate steps. All your session fields are in: profileId, repIndex, kind, plannedMs, delivered, scriptHash, anchorPaired, recoveryCensored, signalSource, endedBy incl. user-stop/timeout, and reps.run returns {session, stop}. driverInstructions(state, stepIndex) in contracts/src/derive.ts gives the submodalities to speak. D-reps-002's fixed order needs superseding on your side. One thing I need: should recode, test and future-pace be logged as RepSessions with trigger.kind 'onboarding'?
